items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
items.claim: The LORD gave Moses a commandment regarding priestly qualifications

items.quote: Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God
items.claim: Priests with physical blemishes are forbidden from performing the priestly service of offering bread
items.actor: Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish
items.action: let him not approach to offer
